descriptions.d31j_build_filtered_image_grid_801877e8: Same sequence as 0x80183ed0: creates the image, loads and configures the texture, then the material, geometry and a modifier whose type depends on option bits 4 and 2048, sets its blend byte on option 1024, derives the cell size, fills UV and step arrays, stores the geometry, creates the instance, applies option setters and computes bounds.
